name: Posledniy svet
source:
When night falls on the camp, for unknown reasons, people engulfed in darkness instantly disappear, the electric lighting stops working, the moon stops shining, and working light sources can't last long under the onslaught of impenetrable darkness. In this hopeless situation, Semyon and his friends in misfortune fight for their lives and try to survive in this dark hell.

[Translated from [url=https://vk.com/wall-196459787_162]VK[/url]]
translation:
当夜幕降临营地时，不知什么原因，被黑暗吞没的人们瞬间消失，电灯停止工作，月亮停止发光，工作光源在无法穿透的黑暗的侵袭下无法维持太久。在这种绝望的情况下，谢苗和他的不幸朋友们为自己的生命而战，并试图在这个黑暗的地狱中生存。

[翻译自[url=https://vk.com/wall-196459787_162]VK[/url]]
